beats.say: A brand DM doesn't always mean a brand deal. The FTC lists five signs it's fake.
One: a brand ambassador manager messages you out of nowhere. Two: heavy flattery about your page or style.
Three: they name-drop real people at the company. Four: they send links to a lookalike website.
Five, the big one: they ask for bank or personal details so payments can start.

show.text: 5. They ask for *bank or personal details*

beats.say: To check, contact the brand on a number you already know is real.
Save this for the next DM, and follow for one income stream every day.

sources.title: FTC consumer alert: bogus brand ambassador managers
